fact: The Ministry of Education, supported by UNICEF Libya, launched the Education Management Information System (EMIS), after a pilot phase for 205 educational institutions and training of thirty staff of the Information and Documentation Center and the Planning and Strategies Department, per the ministry's statement and Undersecretary Masouda Al-Aswad.
The education ministry, with UNICEF, launched the OpenEMIS education management information system, after a pilot in 205 institutions and training of 30 ministry staff.
